Jennetta Richards first participated in the temple ceremonies on January 27, 1844 (see Wilford Woodruff, “Journal [January 1, 1843–December 31, 1844],” Jan. 27, 1844, wilfordwoodruffpapers.org).

Participants referred to this group by several names, including “the Quorum,” “the Holy Order,” and the priesthood (see Heber C. Kimball, “Journal, 1842 September, 1844 May–1845 May,” Sept. 4 1843, Jan. 26, 1845, Heber C. Kimball Papers, 1837–1866, Church History Library, catalog.ChurchofJesusChrist.org; Wilford Woodruff, “Journal [January 1, 1843–December 31, 1844],” Aug. 15, 1844, wilfordwoodruffpapers.org). Later, people referred to the group as the “Anointed Quorum” (see Church History Topics, “Anointed Quorum [‘Holy Order’],” Gospel Library).
See Joseph Smith, “Journal, December 1842–June 1844; Book 3, 15 July 1843–29 February 1844,” Sept. 3, 1843; Sept. 11, 1843; Oct. 12, 1843; Dec. 3, 1843; Feb. 28, 1844, josephsmithpapers.org.
